basis: Native argument builder is STR_EXPRESSION. Omitted and numeric arguments were run and produce distinct Native argument diagnostics at the command line; the public source_only handler instead stops with E_SOURCE_UNIMPLEMENTED.
A well-formed dynamic string expression with a division-by-zero term reaches Native NotImplCodeEE and public E_SOURCE_UNIMPLEMENTED without evaluating the term; AFTER_LOADVAR is unreachable in both.
The existing case207 valid literal form remains a scoped unsupported-handler stop; its planned save/load and post-command observations remain unreachable, not passes.
limitations: No LOADVAR file lookup, valid roundtrip, RESULT/RESULTS update, or post-command state is claimed; the native command handler is an unconditional NotImplCodeEE stub.
Only omitted, numeric, dynamic-expression, and existing valid-literal forms are compared; other malformed syntax and filesystem conditions are excluded.
Native process natural exit and graphical diagnostic rendering were not observed. Native output evidence is the fresh per-run emuera.log; RichEdit GetWindowText returned empty.
The candidate is finite-scope target completion, not complete LOADVAR functionality or universal compatibility.
